“The people have been appalled by all these upheavals for ages.
For all I know Heaven may be open up for a new turn as from Yáo and Shùn
For all I know Heaven may be open up for a new as of the likes of Yáo and Shùn
but I will not (be able) to join up with this."

Such is fate/That's life!” 【1. To the very end of his life WT was an active observer of what was going on around him. 2. This celebrates WT as an 隱居 waiting for an opportunity to join public life whenever the conditions were right.】

1.6.A Wén Zhōngzǐ said: 【Those entries in which WT is referred to by his posthumous name must be collected and compared: what is the significance of this nomenclature?待考】

1.1. A. Wén Zhōngzǐ ***has written: 【0. 文中子 is the honorific posthumous name of WT. This text presents itself explicitly as a posthumous work. 1. This introduction 1.1.A is a written piece: this is not a report of what WT said in any context. It needs to be treated as concise learned composition rather than an oral discourse. 2. In fact, this reads very much like a very personal author's introduction to a 《續論語》envisaged by WT himself. But it may evidently be a later composition by enthusiastic family members and admirers of WT. 3.The frame of this is emphatic/emotional in both the initial and the final lines. 4. The question arises, to what extent the rest of the entries in this book are written compositions as opposed to reported dialogues. This question needs to be faced case by case with regard to each entry.]

1.4 Wén Zhōngzǐ said: 【1. Note the use of WT's posthumous name in this piece. It appears that those who composed this chapter were operating from independent sources which they were aiming to copy exactly even at the risk of being inconistent in the way WT is being referred to. 2. This naming convention is in imitation of the practice in the Analects.】
